headline: Nvidia Q3 Earnings Crush Estimates on AI Chip Demand
summary: Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $35B, up 94% YoY, driven by continued data center demand for Blackwell and Hopper GPUs. Adjusted EPS came in at $0.81 vs consensus $0.75.

headline: Nvidia Raises Full-Year Guidance Amid Data Center Boom
summary: Following strong quarterly results Nvidia raised full-year revenue guidance by $8B, citing sustained hyperscaler capex on AI infrastructure.

headline: Nvidia Launches Next-Gen Blackwell Ultra GPU for Enterprises
summary: The new Blackwell Ultra part targets sovereign AI clouds and enterprise deployments, promising 2x throughput on transformer inference compared to prior Blackwell.

headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Nvidia Price Target to $400 on Sovereign AI Demand
summary: Analyst upgrade cites strong booking momentum from government AI deployments and continued hyperscaler ordering, price target raised from $340 to $400.

headline: EU Opens Antitrust Probe Into Nvidia Over CUDA Software Bundling
summary: European Commission launched a formal investigation into whether Nvidia is unfairly bundling CUDA with its GPU sales, potentially harming AMD and other competitors.

headline: Apple Q4 Revenue Grows on iPhone 17 Strength, Services Hit Record
summary: Apple posted Q4 revenue of $102B, iPhone segment up 8% YoY driven by iPhone 17 launch. Services revenue reached record $30B.

headline: Apple Unveils Vision Pro 2 With Improved Battery Life and Lower Price
summary: Vision Pro 2 debuts at $2499 with 4-hour battery (from 2.5h), lighter design, and expanded content library.

headline: Apple Services Revenue Hits Record Amid App Store and Apple TV+ Growth
summary: The services segment continues to be a bright spot, with App Store take-rate stable and Apple TV+ subscriber growth accelerating post-original-content push.

headline: Apple Reports Slowing iPhone Sales in China as Huawei Rebounds
summary: Greater China revenue fell 4% YoY as Huawei's premium tier reclaims share; Apple accelerates local marketing push for iPhone 17 Pro.

headline: Goldman Downgrades Apple to Neutral Citing China Headwinds
summary: Goldman moved Apple to neutral from buy, citing near-term risks from China market share loss and slower services growth in emerging markets.

headline: Microsoft Q1 Cloud Revenue Up 30%, Azure Leads Growth
summary: Microsoft posted Q1 revenue of $68B with Azure growing 30% YoY, continuing to outpace AWS and GCP growth rates.

headline: Microsoft Doubles Down on OpenAI Partnership With Additional $10B Commitment
summary: Extended multiyear cloud + capital commitment to OpenAI, deepening the Azure exclusivity terms through 2032.

headline: Microsoft Acquires Enterprise AI Startup Neuro for $2.1B
summary: Microsoft announced acquisition of Neuro, an enterprise AI copilot startup, to bolster Copilot for Microsoft 365 with domain-specific reasoning.

headline: Microsoft Copilot Adoption Surges in Fortune 500
summary: Enterprise Copilot deployments grew 3x YoY, with Fortune 500 seat count reaching 12M paid users.

headline: Fed Signals Two More Rate Cuts, Tech Rallies Broadly
summary: Federal Reserve minutes suggest additional easing this year, boosting rate-sensitive growth names including semiconductors and cloud infrastructure providers.
